g.text: Every process of a run lives in one Modal container; the judge, the patient, W&B and the browser reach it from outside.
Modal function train: H100!:4, 16 CPUs, 128 GiB, Miles' image (radixark/miles v0.1.1)
+ rubricrl's source at /root, data/miles at /rubricrl-data, the env venv at /opt/rubricrl-env (uv.lock)
places the actors below on Ray; arguments from training_args()
imports rubricrl for the reward (--reward rm), the agent function (--reward env)
4 × H100, --colocate: on each GPU, one engine and one trainer take turns
rollout: the engines generate, then release their memory;
training: the trainers update Qwen3.5-4B; then weights sync
FSDP -> SGLang and the engines wake for the next step
route generation requests to the 4 engines
its own venv: OpenEnv's server stack stays
out of Miles' Python; holds the judge,
the patient, the SQLite verdict cache
ray start --head --port 6379, 4 GPUs, 16 CPUs: one single-node cluster
the dashboard on :8265, behind Ray's token auth (a fresh token per run)
